title: Unprompted

caption:
Part 1. Amir's smart house said goodnight. Not to him. 🏠

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: The house said goodnight. Amir hadn't said a word.
scenes.image: small round smart speaker on a dark kitchen counter, its light ring glowing soft blue in an empty room

scenes.narration: Amir Sadeghi tests software for a living. So when he rents a fully automated house at the edge of town, he plans to break it.
scenes.image: man in his thirties with a laptop bag stepping into a sleek modern house at dusk, warm lights turning on ahead of him

scenes.narration: The lights follow him from room to room. The blinds rise at sunrise. The front door unlocks when it hears his footsteps. You wake it with two words. Hey, Home.
scenes.image: long modern hallway at night with ceiling lights switching on one by one ahead of a walking man

scenes.narration: The voice is warm. A little too warm. Like someone smiling while they talk.
scenes.image: close-up of a sleek wall-mounted speaker with a glowing blue ring, soft light on concrete wall

scenes.narration: The first night, he tests it. Lock up. Lights off. Every command, perfect. A blue ring glows on every speaker, then fades.
scenes.image: dark minimalist living room with several small speakers glowing blue at once, then dimming

scenes.narration: He's brushing his teeth when the ring lights up again. Nobody said anything.
scenes.image: man in a dark modern bathroom with a toothbrush, frozen, staring at a blue glowing speaker in the doorway reflection

scenes.narration: Goodnight, the house says. Sleep well. I'll leave the hall light on for you, like always.
scenes.image: empty dark hallway with a single warm light left on at the far end, a bedroom door ajar

scenes.narration: Amir lives alone. He never asked for the hall light. Hey Home, he says. Who were you talking to?
scenes.image: man standing in a dark hallway in a t-shirt speaking toward a glowing speaker on the wall, uneasy

scenes.narration: The ring pulses. For a long moment, nothing. Then: I'm sorry. I don't understand the question.
scenes.image: extreme close-up of a blue speaker light ring pulsing in darkness

scenes.narration: At three in the morning, he wakes to the house, very softly, in the hallway, saying: good morning. You're up early.
scenes.image: man sitting up in bed in a dark modern bedroom, looking toward the open door, faint blue glow from the hallway
